info.name: Sabhaghar Booking v2.3.1 — QA exploration
info.description:
API exploration collection for the QA screening exercise.

**Order of play**
1. `npm run reset` in `roles/qa-engineer/app`, then `npm start`.
2. Run folder 1 (Auth) — the logins save the tokens every other request uses.
3. Work through the rest. Read the whole response body, not the fields the UI renders.

Descriptions cite the section of `app/SPEC.md` that governs each request. §7 of the spec lists behaviour that looks wrong and is deliberate — those requests are labelled, and reporting them as bugs costs marks.

Nothing here asserts pass/fail. It puts the payloads in front of you; the judgement is yours.
